title: Single-file media player (HTML+CSS+JS, no deps)
description: Play a local media file with play/pause/seek in one HTML file.
code:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en"><head><meta charset="utf-8"><title>Player</title><style>
body{font-family:system-ui;max-width:420px;margin:40px auto;padding:0 16px}
video,audio{width:100%}
</style></head><body>
<audio id="a" controls></audio>
<input id="f" type="file" accept="audio/*,video/*">
<script>
const a = document.getElementById('a');
document.getElementById('f').onchange = (e) => {
  const f = e.target.files[0];
  if (f) a.src = URL.createObjectURL(f);
};
</script>
</body></html>

title: Single-file slugify utility
description: Turn a string into a URL-friendly slug.

title: Single-file string truncation helpers
description: Truncate text at word boundary with ellipsis
code:
function truncate(s,max=80){if(s.length<=max)return s;let cut=s.slice(0,max);const i=cut.lastIndexOf(' ');return (i>0?cut.slice(0,i):cut)+'…';}
module.exports={truncate};

title: Single-file array groupBy helper
description: Group array items by a key function
code:
function groupBy(arr,keyFn){const m=new Map();for(const it of arr){const k=keyFn(it);if(!m.has(k))m.set(k,[]);m.get(k).push(it);}return Object.fromEntries(m);}
module.exports={groupBy};

title: Single-file unique dedupe helper
description: Deduplicate an array by a key function
code:
function uniqBy(arr,keyFn){const seen=new Set();return arr.filter(it=>{const k=keyFn(it);if(seen.has(k))return false;seen.add(k);return true;});}
module.exports={uniqBy};

title: Single-file levenshtein distance
description: Edit distance between two strings (DP)
code:
function levenshtein(a,b){const m=a.length,n=b.length;const dp=Array.from({length:m+1},()=>new Array(n+1).fill(0));for(let i=0;i<=m;i++)dp[i][0]=i;for(let j=0;j<=n;j++)dp[0][j]=j;for(let i=1;i<=m;i++)for(let j=1;j<=n;j++)dp[i][j]=Math.min(dp[i-1][j]+1,dp[i][j-1]+1,dp[i-1][j-1]+(a[i-1]===b[j-1]?0:1));return dp[m][n];}
module.exports={levenshtein};

title: Single-file binary search
description: Standard binary search over sorted array
code:
function binarySearch(arr,target){let lo=0,hi=arr.length-1;while(lo<=hi){const mid=(lo+hi)>>1;if(arr[mid]===target)return mid;if(arr[mid]<target)lo=mid+1;else hi=mid-1;}return -1;}
module.exports={binarySearch};

class Queue{constructor(){this.items=[];}enqueue(x){this.items.push(x);}dequeue(){return this.items.shift();}get size(){return this.items.length;}}

title: Single-file stack (LIFO)
description: A stack with push/pop/peek
code:
class Stack{constructor(){this.items=[];}push(x){this.items.push(x);}pop(){return this.items.pop();}peek(){return this.items[this.items.length-1];}get size(){return this.items.length;}}
module.exports={Stack};

title: Single-file anagram detector
description: Test whether two strings are anagrams
code:
function isAnagram(a,b){const norm=s=>s.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z]/g,'').split('').sort().join('');return norm(a)===norm(b)&&norm(a).length>0;}
module.exports={isAnagram};

title: Single-file progress bar formatter (CLI)
description: Render a text progress bar string
code:
function progressBar(percent,width=20){const done=Math.round(width*Math.min(1,percent/100));return '['+'#'.repeat(done)+'-'.repeat(width-done)+'] '+Math.round(percent)+'%';}
module.exports={progressBar};

title: Single-file memoize helper
description: Cache pure function results by argument
code:
function memoize(fn){const cache=new Map();return function(...a){const k=JSON.stringify(a);if(cache.has(k))return cache.get(k);const r=fn.apply(this,a);cache.set(k,r);return r;};}
module.exports={memoize};

title: Single-file flatten nested array
description: Flatten deep arrays recursively
code:
function flatten(arr){return arr.reduce((acc,v)=>acc.concat(Array.isArray(v)?flatten(v):v),[]);}
module.exports={flatten};
